data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 was USD 3,314.9m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development of approximately USD 56.8m (about 1.7% of opening reserves) for underwriting years up to 2014, driven principally by adverse development in a subset of earlier years. The period also experienced a number of named natural catastrophe losses in 2016 (Alberta wildfires, Louisiana floods, Hurricane Matthew, Japan earthquake, Houston floods and Gatlinburg wildfires) which are cited as major losses in the report. The prior-year deterioration was identified using the gross claims development table (claims triangle) disclosed in the notes.
raw_causal_phrases: Premium was lower in 2016 as a result of reduced levels of favourable ultimate premium development on prior years compared to 2015.
The Syndicate combined ratio increased to 99.5% (2015: 91.4%), principally reflecting US$56.0m of major losses.
Major losses incurred by the Syndicate were Alberta wildfires, Louisiana floods, Hurricane Matthew, Japan earthquake, Houston floods and Gatlinburg wildfires.
Adjustments to the amounts of the claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the profit and loss account for the period in which the adjustments are made.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was provided in the notes. Prior-year development was computed from the disclosed gross claims development (cumulative claims triangle) by comparing current estimates to the prior diagonal for underwriting years 2011-2014. The triangle in the PDF had parsing irregularities (the '2010 & prior' column values were not fully aligned in the extracted text); the triangle was reconstructed and mapped to columns 2011-2016 for the calculation. Amounts are reported in the native currency (USD millions). Confidence in the PYD number is medium-high (0.8) due to reliance on the triangle reconstruction.
